name: Portugal Apartment Rent Benchmarks
license: Derived benchmark metadata for in-app guidance; verify upstream source terms before redistribution
description: City-specific long-term apartment-rent benchmarks for Lisbon, Porto, and Faro. This dataset is intentionally limited to apartment rentals and excludes detached-house rentals, holiday lets, and non-residential inventory.
preprocessing: Built a compact benchmark dataset from current Portugal city rent guides already retrievable by NestGPT
Kept only one-bedroom apartment-style monthly rent benchmarks for supported cities
Excluded house rentals, short-term holiday lets, and non-residential inventory
Stored a small prompt-sized sample with notes and upstream source URLs per record
